timeline.title: First day at Asian Grammar School
timeline.body: Nine years in Gothatuwa that ended with O/Ls — and a growing habit of taking things apart to see how they work.

timeline.title: Joined the Leo Club
timeline.body: Member of the Leo Club of Asian Grammar School — first taste of organising people and projects for the community.

timeline.title: St. Benedict's College
timeline.body: A/Ls in the Physical Science stream: maths, physics and a lot of problem sets.

timeline.title: Leo Club of Kottawa Central Golden City
timeline.body: Continued community service with the Omega club through 2021, sharpening leadership and teamwork.

timeline.title: Started Computer Science at IIT
timeline.body: BSc (Hons) at the Informatics Institute of Technology, affiliated with the University of Westminster.

timeline.title: Shipped my first systems
timeline.body: Library and Inventory Management Systems in Java, JavaFX and MySQL — where OOP and layered architecture finally clicked. Six University of Moratuwa certificates and five HackerRank badges along the way.

timeline.title: Software Engineer Intern at Innovation Quotient
timeline.body: Joined IQ in May. Secure APIs, database design and React front-ends for client projects — including an HR information system.

timeline.title: Associate Software Engineer
timeline.body: Promoted in January. Now building health-tech, OTT streaming, logistics and children's-events platforms with .NET Core, React, Next.js, Flutter and Azure — while building HelioGuard, my final-year research project on explainable solar-flare forecasting. Also revamping the HDO website as a freelance project.
